access_id.description: Access Id for connection to HPP session. Only required if distribution method is 'token'

email.description: Email where to send the email with the HPP link. Only required if distribution method is 'email'

phone.description: Phone number where to send the sms with the HPP link. Only required if distribution method is 'sms'

phone_country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 phone country. Only required if distribution method is 'sms'
